reviews.text: We did our new house blinds installation with Slick Blinds Ravi and his team. Truly very professional and Excellent quality blinds and accurate measured blinds were installed by there team. We were very happy with wide range and choice of blinds offerred by this company.

The team from Slick Blinds did an amazing job on my installation! They were extremely cordial, friendly and efficient, and not to mention the exquisite quality of these shades. I couldn’t be happier! I highly recommend Slick Blinds to folks looking for quality products and outstanding customer service!

Ravi and his team were very efficient throughout the process. They helped us select the styles, took measurements, ordered, and installed them promptly and on schedule. The output came out to be much better than what was shown in the pictures. Really glad we chose Slick blinds for our home, and highly recommend giving them a shot!

We have got automated blinds installed from slick blinds had a very good experience from coming in to take measurements to installation and the pricing was very reasonable. I strongly recommend them for blinds.
Thanks to Ravi and Team . They fixed the issue immediately within short notice of time. I recommend Slick Blinds for their prompt customer service.
Ravi and his team’s customer service has been excellent. They offer a better selection and variety of products compared to the competition.
Ravi and team have been incredible. Great service and good selection of products. Highly recommended
